rationale: While Salesforce ISV API opacity is a real and historically documented pain, the evidence base for this specific sub-problem (SignupRequest/Trialforce C-1016 errors in CI/CD pipelines) is a single forum post. The addressable segment—ISV partners automating org provisioning via headless CI—is a narrow slice within an already narrow ISV ecosystem, and no willingness-to-pay signal (competitor pricing, 'is there a tool that…' requests, job postings) could be identified beyond inference from the broader Salesforce tooling market. Insufficient distinct pain quotes and no WTP evidence to meet the pass bar; marking rejected rather than inconclusive because the niche is too narrow to expect evidence accumulation in a re-queue cycle.
